exitCodes.name: ERROR
exitCodes.description: The command ran, but the operation failed.

exitCodes.name: TIMED_OUT
exitCodes.description: A request timed out. The operation may still have completed on the server.

exitCodes.name: BAD_INIT
exitCodes.description: The command could not start because of invalid input or setup, such as arguments, flags, files or configuration.

errors.name: InvalidConfigError
errors.title: Invalid configuration file
errors.fix: Fix the reported problem in `hive.json` (or the file set with `HIVE_CONFIG`). Supported keys are `registry.endpoint`, `registry.accessToken`, `registry.headers`, `cdn.endpoint` and `cdn.accessToken`. When `HIVE_SPACE` is set, the file must contain a top-level key with that name.

errors.name: InvalidCommandError
errors.title: Unknown command
errors.fix: Run `hive help` to list the available commands and check the spelling.

errors.name: MissingArgumentsError
errors.title: Missing required argument
errors.fix: Provide the listed arguments or flags. Organization access tokens always require the `--target` flag.

errors.name: MissingRegistryTokenError
errors.title: Missing registry access token
errors.fix: Pass `--registry.accessToken`, set `HIVE_TOKEN`, or set `registry.accessToken` in `hive.json`.

errors.name: MissingCdnKeyError
errors.title: Missing CDN access token
errors.fix: Pass `--cdn.accessToken`, set `HIVE_CDN_ACCESS_TOKEN`, or set `cdn.accessToken` in `hive.json`.

errors.name: MissingEndpointError
errors.title: Missing registry endpoint
errors.fix: Pass `--registry.endpoint`, set `HIVE_REGISTRY`, or set `registry.endpoint` in `hive.json`. Make sure `HIVE_REGISTRY` is not set to an empty string.

errors.name: InvalidRegistryTokenError
errors.title: Invalid registry access token
errors.fix: Create a new access token, and check that the access token and the registry endpoint belong to the same Hive instance.

errors.name: InvalidCdnKeyError
errors.title: Invalid CDN access token
errors.fix: Create a new CDN access token for the target, and check that it belongs to the same target as the CDN endpoint.

errors.name: MissingCdnEndpointError
errors.title: Missing CDN endpoint
errors.fix: Pass `--cdn.endpoint`, set `HIVE_CDN_ENDPOINT`, or set `cdn.endpoint` in `hive.json`.

errors.name: MissingEnvironmentError
errors.title: Missing environment variable
errors.fix: Set the listed environment variables. With `--github`, run the command in GitHub Actions or set `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`.

errors.name: CommitRequiredError
errors.title: Missing commit
errors.fix: Pass `--commit` (or set `HIVE_COMMIT` for `schema:publish`), or run the command inside a git repository.

errors.name: GithubRepositoryRequiredError
errors.title: Missing GitHub repository
errors.fix: Run the command in GitHub Actions, where `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is set, or in a CI environment that exposes the repository.

errors.name: AuthorRequiredError
errors.title: Missing author
errors.fix: Pass `--author` (or set `HIVE_AUTHOR` for `schema:publish`), or run the command inside a git repository with a configured user.

errors.name: HTTPError
errors.title: HTTP error response
errors.fix: A 4xx status usually means a wrong endpoint or a rejected request: check the endpoint URL and credentials. A 5xx status means the server failed: retry later.

errors.name: NetworkError
errors.title: Network error
errors.fix: The request did not complete. Check the network connection, DNS, proxy and TLS settings, and the endpoint URL, then retry.

errors.name: APIError
errors.title: API error
errors.fix: Read the message returned by the Hive API. Include the request ID when contacting support.

errors.name: IntrospectionError
errors.title: Introspection failed
errors.fix: Make sure the service is running, reachable and allows introspection, or pass the schema file instead of the URL.

errors.name: UnsupportedFileExtensionError
errors.title: Unsupported file extension
errors.fix: Use one of the supported file extensions listed in the message.

errors.name: FileMissingError
errors.title: File not found
errors.fix: Check that the path or glob matches at least one readable file.

errors.name: InvalidFileContentsError
errors.title: Invalid file contents
errors.fix: Make sure the file is readable and contains valid content in the expected format.

errors.name: InvalidTargetError
errors.title: Invalid target
errors.fix: Pass the target as a slug in the form `organization/project/target`, or as a target UUID.

errors.name: InvalidFederationSubgraphError
errors.title: Not a Federation subgraph
errors.fix: Point the URL at a Federation subgraph that exposes `Query._service.sdl`, or pass the schema file instead.

errors.name: InvalidVersionIdError
errors.title: Invalid schema version ID
errors.fix: Pass the ID of a schema version from the same project as the target.

errors.name: ConflictingOptionsError
errors.title: Conflicting options
errors.fix: Provide only one of the listed options.

errors.name: AccessDeniedError
errors.title: Access denied
errors.fix: Grant the named permission to the access token, check that `--target` points at an existing target the token can access, or use an organization access token.

errors.name: UnsupportedServerError
errors.title: Unsupported Hive server version
errors.fix: Upgrade the Hive server to a version that supports this CLI version, or use an older CLI version that matches the server. Nothing was executed on the server.

errors.name: RequestTimeoutError
errors.title: Request timed out
errors.fix: The operation may have completed on the server. Check its result, for example in Hive Console or with `hive schema:fetch`, before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidInputError
errors.title: Invalid command input
errors.fix: Check the arguments and flags with `hive help <command>`.

errors.name: InvalidHeaderError
errors.title: Invalid header
errors.fix: Use the `Name=Value` format for `--registry.header` and the `Name:Value` format for `--header`.

errors.name: UnexpectedError
errors.title: Unexpected error
errors.fix: Re-run the command with `DEBUG=*` for more details, and report the output if the problem persists.

errors.name: SchemaFileNotFoundError
errors.title: Schema not found
errors.fix: Check the file path, glob or URL. For a URL, make sure the service is reachable.

errors.name: SchemaFileEmptyError
errors.title: No type definitions found
errors.fix: Make sure the schema contains GraphQL type definitions. In code files, the definitions must be in a template literal tagged with `gql` or `graphql`, or marked with a `/* GraphQL */` comment.

errors.name: SchemaCheckFailedError
errors.title: Schema check failed
errors.fix: Review the errors and breaking changes in the output or the linked report. Fix them, approve expected breaking changes in Hive Console, or use `--forceSafe`.

errors.name: SchemaCheckApprovalFailedError
errors.title: Schema check approval failed
errors.fix: Make sure the access token has the `schemaCheck:approve` permission and that the failed schema check was stored by the registry.

errors.name: SchemaPublishFailedError
errors.title: Schema publish failed
errors.fix: The schema was rejected and nothing was stored. Fix the reported errors and publish again.

errors.name: InvalidSDLError
errors.title: Invalid SDL
errors.fix: Fix the GraphQL syntax error at the reported location.

errors.name: SchemaPublishMissingServiceError
errors.title: Missing service name
errors.fix: Pass `--service <name>`. Federation and schema stitching projects require a service name.

errors.name: SchemaPublishMissingUrlError
errors.title: Missing service URL
errors.fix: Pass `--url <url>`. A service needs a URL the first time it is published, and the URL must be valid.

errors.name: PersistedOperationsMalformedError
errors.title: Malformed persisted documents
errors.fix: Use a GraphQL Code Generator, Relay or Apollo persisted query manifest, a directory of `.graphql` files, or a glob that matches `.graphql` files containing operations.

errors.name: InvalidPersistedDocumentsError
errors.title: Invalid operations
errors.fix: Fix the listed operations so they comply with the requirements.

errors.name: SchemaNotFoundError
errors.title: Schema not found in the registry
errors.fix: Publish a schema to the target first, or check the target, the commit and the `--type` value.

errors.name: InvalidSchemaError
errors.title: Schema version is not valid
errors.fix: The requested schema version is not valid. Use a different commit, or fix and publish the schema again.

errors.name: ServiceAndUrlLengthMismatch
errors.title: Service and URL count mismatch
errors.fix: Pass exactly one `--url` for every `--service`.

errors.name: LocalCompositionError
errors.title: Local composition failed
errors.fix: Fix the composition errors in the listed subgraphs.

errors.name: RemoteCompositionError
errors.title: Remote composition failed
errors.fix: Fix the composition errors in the listed subgraphs.

errors.name: InvalidCompositionResultError
errors.title: Invalid composition result
errors.fix: The composed supergraph is invalid. Report the output as a bug.

errors.name: InvalidDocumentsError
errors.title: Invalid operations
errors.fix: Fix the listed operations so that they are valid against the schema.
